data.description:
Don’t. Let. Them. Find. You.
Hush is a game  where you have to escape from the robots without them noticing. Or they’ll kill you.

Release notes: https://hushgame.co/release-notes

changelog.change_log:
Exciting Updates in Hush!
👾 More Thrilling Levels

New introduction level: Discover the dark side of the Lumirios while everything seems friendly… at first!
A quick and efficient tutorial: Learn everything you need in just one level.
🌟 More Interaction and Challenges

See what’s missing to complete stars directly from the lobby.
New abilities! Control two characters with unique powers:
Flash grenade: Temporarily blinds Vibros.
Grappling hook: Swing across obstacles in style.
Time Stop: Slows down the vibros for a few seconds.
🎭 A More Immersive Story

Find Lumirios’ notes revealing their sinister plans.
Jamie’s calls now show a distorted version of their face, adding more mystery!
🎮 Gameplay Enhancements

Vibros and Lumirios have improved vision zones that adapt to walls and doors.
Tired of waiting? Speed up time!
🎵 Unique Music in Each Level

Every level features its own soundtrack to keep the experience fresh.
🛠️ Level Editor Ready

The level editor is now available, so you can start creating your own adventures!
🌥️ A More Beautiful Lobby

New cloud designs blend with the previous ones for a magical look.
🌌 Tougher Enemy Challenges

Vibros and Lumirios now behave unpredictably… get ready for surprises!
Dive into the world of Hush, create, explore, and enjoy! 🎮✨

- Bug fix
- English language as default.
- Floor visual change in levels

- Leaderboards and achievements to make it fun to see who's the best at every level 
- Bug fixes to make everything smoooooth
*New in this version*: Multiplayer support and bug fixes
